styles: .live-btn{ display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:12px 26px; border:2px solid #1c7c3f; border-radius:40px; background:#a8d9b8; font-weight:700; font-family:Arial, sans-serif; color:#0e5c2a; animation:buttonPulse 2s infinite; cursor:default; } .live-btn:hover{ color:#0e5c2a; } .live-dot{ width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%; animation:dotColor 1.2s infinite; } @keyframes dotColor{ 0%{background:var(--pti-green);} 50%{background:var(--pti-red);} 100%{background:var(--pti-green);} } @keyframes buttonPulse{ 0%{ transform:scale(1); box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(0,176,80,0.5); } 50%{ transform:scale(1.05); box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(0,176,80,0.7); } 100%{ transform:scale(1); box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(0,176,80,0.5); } }
